title: Enhanced electrocatalytic activity and stability of Ce doped NiFe layered double hydroxide for alkaline seawater oxidation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00201C, Paper
Luhuan Yang, Bifeng Wang, Meilan Xu, Lingfeng Li, Qinglan Ye, Xuetang Xu, Fan Wang
A NiFeCe LDH electrode achieves 500 mA cm−2 at an overpotential of 288 mV in alkaline simulated seawater, with high stability for 600 h.
